row.name: HNI Corporation Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=35 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.25 tightness=0.64 base_volume_vs_leg=0.76 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 35 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -0.4% vs its 20-SMA, -3.4% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: VOL is a hard FAIL with a base over 21 sessions requiring the catalyst-volume rule (cv_required=true), volume came in at only 0.83x the prior session and 0.92x the 50-session average against a 1.5x requirement — the single most decisive measured defect. The base itself is 35 sessions, well outside Bonde's 3–20 window, and the chart shows a long, wide, overlapping consolidation from mid-August through late September with multiple red bars and visible whippy price action inside the shaded box. The prior leg is genuinely linear (R²=0.93, ER=0.47) but the combination of a failed volume check and a loose, extended base makes this a C-grade setup.
claude.key_risk: Volume failed the catalyst requirement for a base this long, and the wide overlapping bars in the 35-session consolidation mean any follow-through is unreliable.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 46.73 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is again running well below average with no visible buying pressure.
